newsitem.title: Netherlands: BEGEMANN H1 NET PROFIT NLG 14.2 MLN.
newsitem.headline: BEGEMANN H1 NET PROFIT NLG 14.2 MLN.

text.p: First-half 1996.
(Millions of guilders unless otherwise stated.
Net per shr (guilders) 2.80 vs N.A.
Net profit 14.2 vs 141.6 loss
Income from holdings 28.3 vs 53.9
Management costs 5.7 vs 11.5
Net financial charges 8.4 vs 30.7
Net operating profit before tax 14.2 vs 11.7
Net operating profit before tax 14.2 vs 11.7
Extraordinary charges nil vs 153.3
NOTE - Comparative figures are for FULL-YEAR 1995.
Koninklijke Begemann Groep NV has holdings in some 40
industrial companies.
Its income from holdings consists of dividends and interest
plus book profits or losses on the purchase or sale of holdings.
Begemann said that for the whole of 1996 it expected a small
net profit, excluding results from the purchase or sale of
holdings. It said it was unable to make a forecast of overall
net profit for the whole of 1996 because of uncertainty about
the level of results from the purchase or sale of holdings.
In first-half 1996 such transactions produced a book loss of
3.9 mln guilders versus a 35.7 mln profit in all of 1995.
